about: Character art made with Higgsfield (model gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, resolution 1k unless a request says otherwise, background transparent: 0.5 credits an image at 1k, 1 at 2k). Each request is one image; tools/import_generated.py cuts it into the named sprites, matching figures to outputs left to right. refs are the reference images given to the model, in order.

references.ref_bodies: npc_walt, npc_maya and player_idle side by side on white: style, proportions and pose
references.ref_faces: face_walt_neutral, face_maya_content and face_june_gentle side by side on white: portrait style and framing
references.<name>_body: the generated full-body image of that character: keeps the portraits consistent with the sprite
references.ref_items: item_coffee_mug, item_teacup, item_picnic_basket, item_camera and item_novel side by side on white: item style
references.ref_player_poses: art/source/player_poses.png on white, 1280 px: the player character's look, style and scale
references.ref_furniture: art/source/furniture.png on white, 1280 px: furniture style (linework, texture, three-quarter view)
references.style_laundromat: the new laundromat background (web/assets/bg/laundromat.webp, world x 560-2080), 1520x720: the flat 2D style every prop matches
references.style_chars: player_idle and the eight npc_* sprites side by side on cream: the characters' drawing style
references.ref_player_sit: player_idle, player_sit, player_knit and player_fold side by side on white, at one scale: the player's look for new poses
references.blockings: art/source/blockings/: the flat colour blockings every scene was painted from (blocking.py draws them)

style: See the prompts: every request asks for the game's hand-painted style (ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading) and a transparent background.

scenes.about: v1.4: every scene is painted as flat 2D from a flat colour blocking drawn in world px by art/source/blockings/blocking.py (then padded to the model's aspect ratio: interiors at the bottom, exteriors at the top), so each painting lands on known coordinates. gpt_image_2_5, quality medium, 4K for the big scenes (1.25 credits), 2K/1K for the skyline and window views. Glass and sky are painted pure white and cut out on import; night versions are edits of the day painting (the day image as the only reference) and become *_lights.webp layers. The import command for each is below.

laundromat.prompt: The interior of Rosa's, a small old neighbourhood laundromat, as one long flat back wall. STRICT FLAT 2D: a pure orthographic front elevation with no perspective at all, no vanishing points, no side walls, no receding planes; like an architectural elevation drawing or a theatre backdrop. The first reference image is a flat colour blocking: keep EXACTLY its composition, proportions, heights and positions. Match the style of the second reference: fine dark-brown ink outlines, textured gouache and coloured-pencil shading with subtle paper grain, warm muted palette. Left to right: a wooden door with a small window and an UPSTAIRS sign; a blank dark-green chalkboard; a copper water line with a red and a blue tap over each of five washer bays; two ribbed dryer vent ducts and a small LINT sign; four teal pendant lamps; the shop front: a big window with three transom panes and a sill, and a teal glass door. Pressed-tin ceiling, mint plaster, chair rail, cream tiles, teal baseboard; a flat teal-and-cream checkerboard floor band with a drain and a WELCOME mat. All glass flat pure white. No machines, furniture, clock, plants, bags or people.

linden.closed: Delgado's storefront (a 580x725 crop of the painting at 2644,627) edited closed down: papered window with a FOR LEASE sign, empty shelves, dark door with a CLOSED card, faded sign; pasted back feathered.
